correctness.rationale: The linear output-unclustered condition means the five neighboring pairs of the six-letter BWT last column are unequal; input runs are cyclic. Every primitive length-six necklace uses t<=6 distinct symbols, and unique increasing relabeling reduces to a surjective t-letter canonical necklace. Independently enumerated all t^6 length-six candidates, retained lexicographically minimal primitive rotations, computed actual sorted-rotation BWT, filtered consecutive output equality, and counted cyclic input boundaries. Complete eight histogram cells (t,r)=(3,4):5,(3,6):1,(4,4):14,(4,5):44,(4,6):20,(5,5):72,(5,6):108,(6,6):120 sum to 384. Each normalized object has exactly C(q,t) increasing lifts, giving all three displayed E_q,r polynomials for every q>=1; the 4-run fraction is 7/(2q^2)+O(q^-3). No finite-q extrapolation is used.
